events.summary: Jen-Hsun Huang, co-founder, on the board since inception (April 1993).
Tench Coxe joins board.
Mark A. Stevens joins board (first stint).
Harvey C. Jones joins board.
A. Brooke Seawell joins board.
James C. Gaither joins board.
Mark L. Perry elected to the board (effective 2005-05-17).
Board increased from eight to nine for Perry.
Mark A. Stevens retires at the 2006 annual meeting at the end of his term.
Board reduced from nine to eight on Stevens' retirement.
Mark A. Stevens rejoins the board.
Board increased from eight to nine for Stevens' return.
Robert K. Burgess appointed to the board.
Dawn Hudson appointed to the board.
Michael G. McCaffery appointed to the board (and the AC).
Persis S. Drell appointed to the board.
Mark L. Perry becomes Lead Director (effective March 2018).
Stephen C. Neal appointed to the board.
James C. Gaither retires, not standing for re-election at the 2020 annual meeting.
Board goes from 12 to 11 members at the 2020 meeting on Gaither's retirement.
John O. Dabiri appointed to the board.
Aarti Shah appointed to the board.
Stephen C. Neal succeeds Mark L. Perry as Lead Director at the 2023 annual meeting.
Mark L. Perry's Lead Director term ends at the 2023 annual meeting.
Melissa B. Lora appointed to the board (and the AC).
Board increased from thirteen to fourteen for Lora.
Mark L. Perry does not stand for re-election; service ends at the 2024 annual meeting.
Michael G. McCaffery does not stand for re-election; service ends at the 2024 annual meeting.
Board reduced from 14 to 12 at the 2024 meeting.
Ellen Ochoa appointed to the board.
Board increased from twelve to thirteen for Ochoa.
Ellen Ochoa resigns for personal reasons, effective immediately.
Robert K. Burgess dies in December 2025 while serving as a director (disclosed in the 2026 proxy).
Persis S. Drell resigns, effective immediately, to pursue a new professional opportunity.
Suzanne Nora Johnson joins the board (and the AC), effective 2026-07-13.
Board increased from ten to eleven for Nora Johnson (approved 2026-05-07).

conflicts.description: Gaither's start year. The IPO prospectus says he had been a director 'since December 1998', the 2019 proxy table says 'Director Since 1998', and the 2020 proxy's '22 years as a Board member' also points to 1998. But one sentence of the 2020 proxy says he 'has served on our Board since 1999'. Kept December 1998 (the contemporaneous prospectus).

Hudson's appointment day. EDGAR's index metadata for her 8-K lists a report date of 2013-07-17, but the 8-K cover ('earliest event reported') and body both say July 18, 2013, and her Form 3 event date is 2013-07-18. Kept 2013-07-18.

Board-size bookkeeping has gaps. No filing states an increase when Dabiri and Shah joined in 2020 (11 members after the 2020 meeting, 13 nominees in 2021). Nor does any filing record a reduction after Ochoa (July 2025), Burgess (December 2025) and Drell (January 2026) left, yet the May 2026 8-K increases the board 'from ten to eleven'. Only disclosed changes are recorded as BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events.

open_questions: Exact date of Robert K. Burgess's death. The 2026 proxy says only 'December 2025'. No 8-K was filed and no other filing gives the day, so his end date is month precision.

Suzanne Nora Johnson (joined 2026-07-13) has no independence determination in any filing through 2026-09-23. Her 8-K and the 2026 proxy put her on the Audit Committee, which implies independence under Nasdaq rules, but no independence role is recorded until the 2027 proxy states it.

Pre-IPO start dates are disclosed only to the month (Huang April 1993, Coxe and Stevens June 1993, Jones November 1993, Seawell December 1997, Gaither December 1998). For Huang the month comes from 'since its inception' plus the April 1993 incorporation. EDGAR full-text search starts in 2001 and finds no more precise date.

Stevens' first stint is recorded as ending on the 2006 annual meeting date (2006-06-22). The 2006 proxy says he retires at that meeting and the 2006 10-Q confirms it was held then. No 8-K Item 5.07 existed at the time.
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations only (every proxy says all directors except Huang are independent). Pre-IPO tenure has no determination.

Burgess's committee after the 2025 meeting (NCGC) appears only in the 2025 proxy's forward-looking 'After 2025 Meeting' column. The recorded committee snapshot uses the 'Until 2025 Meeting' column (CC).

Other-board lists come from NVIDIA's own bios in each person's latest NVIDIA proxy and were not checked against other issuers' filings. Most bios do not say whether a company is public (public_company_stated_in_source=false). Gaither's 2019 bio names only non-profits.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A, the 2026 Item 5.07 results, and every 8-K (including all with Item 5.02), Form 3 and Form 4 filed after the proxy through 2026-09-23, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed.

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed. Annual-meeting slates compared year over year. Departures dated from 8-K Item 5.02, from the Item 5.07 meeting date for directors who did not stand, or (Burgess) from the 2026 proxy.

Pre-2020 seats only for directors serving in 2020 or later. Reconstructed from the IPO prospectus, proxies, appointment 8-Ks and Forms 3. Other pre-2020 directors (e.g., William J. Miller, Steven Chu) are not recorded.
